points.description: States both functions: push (add an item to the top of the stack) and pop (remove an item from the top of the stack). Names push and pop in any wording or case.
points.partial_credit: 2 marks if only one of push or pop is correctly named, or both are named alongside a minor error.

points.description: Gives the correct basic meaning of the operations: push adds an element to the top, pop removes the top element.
points.partial_credit: 0.5 if only one operation's meaning is correct.

rubric.notes: Full marks for naming both push and pop, in any wording; a brief answer like "push and pop" earns 5 if the meanings are not contradicted, so give the P2 mark unless the student gives a wrong meaning. Part marks if only one of the two is named, or if one is named with a wrong description. Naming other operations such as peek, top, or isEmpty instead of push and pop earns nothing for those items.
